title: Requirements quality and ownership
description: Defines the mandatory minimum for the Product-owned build contract.

rules.statement: The Product role owns and explicitly approves product behavior, business rules, scope, success measures, and acceptance criteria before implementation.
requiredEvidence: Approved product-management.requirements Artifact and content hash

rules.statement: Material open questions and contradictions must be resolved before Build Readiness passes.
Acceptance criteria must be observable and traceable to the approved requirements and verification evidence.
